Point mid to backItr. Assign backItr as mid, mid as frontItr and

Approach:
Why would you want to have a length property in LinkedList ?
- Efficiency: Without it, determining the length requires traversing the entire 
list, which takes O(n) time instead of O(1) time
- Simplicity: It simplifies implementation of algorithms that rely on size of 
the list. Ex: operations like finding median, splitting list
- Error Checking: It can help with error checking and validation. 
Ex: you can quickly check if list is empty or if it contains more elements 
than a threshold
